metadata.question: Did more forest area burn in Sakha in 2015 than compared to 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use MODIS or Landsat burned area products to detect forest fires - Compare burned area in Sakha (Russia) for 2015 vs 2021 - MODIS MCD64A1 (burned area) is ideal for this comparison - Define Sakha region geometry (approximate bounding box) 2. Masking strategy: - Burned area products already have quality flags - No cloud masking needed; we're using validated burned area data - Filter by pixel count to detect valid data 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs. Null: - Valid Zero (A/B): Legitimate burned area value (could be 0 or positive) - Null/Error (C3): If calculation returns None or out-of-range values - C1: If no burned area data exists for either year - C2: If after processing, no valid pixels remain ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Sakha region (approximate bounding box) const sakha = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([105, 62, 135, 76]); // lon/lat // 2. Load MODIS Burned Area product const burnedArea = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD64A1'); // 3. Filter for 2015 const burned2015 = burnedArea .filterDate('2015-01-01', '2015-12-31') .filterBounds(sakha) .select('BurnDate'); // 4. Filter for 2021 const burned2021 = burnedArea .filterDate('2021-01-01', '2021-12-31') .filterBounds(sakha) .select('BurnDate'); // 5. Check data availability const size2015 = burned2015.size().getInfo(); const size2021 = burned2021.size().getInfo(); print(`2015 Images: ${size2015}, 2021 Images: ${size2021}`); if (size2015 === 0 || size2021 === 0) { print("C1: Empty Collection - no burned area data for one or both years"); return; } // 6. Mosaic and calculate burned area for each year const mosaic2015 = burned2015.mosaic(); const mosaic2021 = burned2021.mosaic(); // 7. Count valid burned pixels (BurnDate > 0 means burned) const burnedPixels2015 = mosaic2015.gt(0).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: sakha, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('BurnDate').getInfo(); const burnedPixels2021 = mosaic2021.gt(0).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: sakha, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('BurnDate').getInfo(); print(`2015 Burned Pixels: ${burnedPixels2015}, 2021 Burned Pixels: ${burnedPixels2021}`); // 8. Validate results if (burnedPixels2015 === null || burnedPixels2021 === null) { print("C3: Calculation Failure - null result"); return; } if (burnedPixels2015 === 0 && burnedPixels2021 === 0) { print("C2: No Valid Pixels - no burned areas detected in either year"); return; } // 9. Compare burned area const burnedArea2015 = burnedPixels2015 * 500 * 500 / 1e6; // Convert to km² const burnedArea2021 = burnedPixels2021 * 500 * 500 / 1e6; print(`2015 Burned Area: ${burnedArea2015.toFixed(0)} km²`); print(`2021 Burned Area: ${burnedArea2021.toFixed(0)} km²`); // 10. Final answer if (burnedArea2015 > burnedArea2021) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
